summary.text: Brian Minier is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-11 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brian Minier was born in Omaha, Nebraska, and lives in Vermont.
Minier earned a bachelor's degree in psychology and master's degrees in Russian, east European, and Central Asian area studies and in Slavic languages and literature.
Minier's career experience includes working as a secretary in the German and Russian department at the University of Vermont.
Minier was elected to the South Burlington school board in 2019 and served until March 2022.
